svg.title: Namecheap transfer: check the year before counting it
svg.desc: Eligible generic domains normally gain a year; some UK and IM extensions do not renew; AI renews two years. Expired then renewed domains need a 45-day check. Actual account transfer not verified.

g.text: A transfer does not always mean +1 year
Official rules reviewed 2026-10-25 · No account transfer tested
Generic: usually +1 year · Listed UK/IM: no renewal · .ai: +2 years
Expired, then renewed? Read the official 45-day warning.
A published rule is not a completed-transfer receipt.
Account expiry / transfer coupon / bill: not verified
